name: 1.1.2 - New buyers' COSTAR accounts
notes: A new buyer (COSTAR's Customer Not found) gets a COSTAR customer account when the eBay order has every detail COSTAR's new-customer form asks for: the magnifier beside Account#, Add new, every box checked against the order, OK once per order, then Ship to. A detail missing: no account, the order goes on as before.
